# V Modern Italian

> Italian Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Dinner, drinks and late nights in a 7,400-square-foot room of dark walnut, marble and velvet, under a mural by PichiAvo, with a DJ spinning.

- Phone: (656) 218-4022
- Address: 1701 W North A St, Tampa, FL 33606
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Antipasti and pasta; Steaks and mare e terra; Cocktails and dolci
- Rating: 4.7 from 668 Google reviews
